summary: Park-edge kerb on a quiet residential street; houses across the road.
reasons: Houses about 20 m across the road

best_section.where: Park-side kerb of the street where it bends, just south-west of the pin under the large trees

drivers.seclusion: Park lawn and trees on the van's side; homes sit on the opposite side of the street roughly 20 m away and others along the road to the south-west.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed public street, plain kerb beside the park with no gate; width looks enough to park fully at the kerb.
drivers.traffic: Quiet suburban street serving a few houses; light local traffic.
drivers.convention: Only a handful of cars on the street, none clearly parked overnight; no sign of campers.

flags: Homes about 20 m across the road, close to the 25 m mark
Low-lying: about 8 m elevation, Brisbane River 276 m away
Kerb between pin and houses has no parking convention
Pin sits on the park corner; a steeper bank of about 14% max lies near the pin but not on the kerb
sun_shade: Large trees at the pin shade the kerb from the north-east and overhead; open to afternoon sun from the west across the park.
